scope: Preserve exact same-owner passing handback across driving brain retirement; not cross-owner adoption
finding: DrivingOperationFinish releases then clears its brain. Pending PassFinish previously required that brain generation; RetireInherited also treated a finished/missing brain as an inherited path. Discovery could increment executor generation over the original pending cap/order. Authored return route metadata contains no owner epoch.
implementation: Capture handbackOwner=[owner,epoch,generation] at original passing STOP. Pending cleanup always checks current stamp; only an empty brain with exactly that original stamp may substitute for the retired brain generation.
RetireInherited leaves exact same-owner stamped pending passing work to its existing observer even after brain retirement, avoiding another stop/route request.

DrivingOperationStart reuses its existing per-vehicle traversal to service pending passing STOP/return before publishing a new executor. Exact same-order pending receipts block new generation; changed route/owner revokes old cleanup. No new scan/timer/worker.

PASS_RETURN includes passReturnOwner in cleanup signature. RecoveryRelease treats changed owner stamp or authored route as LOST before pending/expired classification, so new orders do not wait for an obsolete old goal.
remaining: Genuine inherited public passing-leg cleanup still uses its separate existing stop/route path; it has not been converted to deferred exact acknowledgement or adopted private pending work.
Native passing remains disabled pending original-native-route provenance during its temporary path and real cleanup integration.

Physical same-owner brain shutdown, new-order/owner revocation, inherited leg/locality timing, both-seat acknowledgement and actual original-route travel remain unverified; measure performance when audits authorized.
limits: Unsigned dirty development snapshot preserving unrelated dirt; notes afterward. Original deadline unchanged, no score renewal or physical/whole-HBQ parity claim. Audits paused.
